summary.storyTitle: Story 4: Chunk Derivation and Compact Recovery
summary.implementedScope: Addressed SV-04-001 by making background chunk-summary input reads preserve chunk_member rows that reference missing canonical turn rows, surfacing them as source corruption before any provider summary call. The chunk summary handler now blocks both detailed and brief summaries on that corruption, while sanctioned SDK soft-deletes remain filtered so survivor-only chunk rebuilds still pass.
